address: Taman Jurong Market & Food Centre, #02-66, 3 Yung Sheng Road, Jurong West, 618499, Singapore
bio: Open mornings only, this stall is famous for its Cantonese barbecue that tends to sell out quickly - so come early! Roast duck boasts velvety meat without being too fatty and the roast pork strikes a fine balance between lean and fatty meat....
